import 'package:adele_ui/capability_bridge.dart';
import 'package:adele_ui/environment_capability_bridge.dart';
import 'package:adele_ui/main_content_bridge.dart';
import 'package:capability_probe_contract/contract.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

const capability = 'test.capability.buffered';

void initialize() {
  openMainContentPane('probe', 'Buffered semantic consumer', false);
}

Widget buildPane() => BufferedProbe();

class BufferedProbe extends StatefulWidget {
  @override
  State<BufferedProbe> createState() => BufferedProbeState();
}

class BufferedProbeState extends State<BufferedProbe> {
  String selection = 'idle';
  String text = 'process:idle';
  dynamic client;
  List<String> handles = [];
  bool disposed = false;

  void select(String? provider, bool readOnly) async {
    final handle = readOnly
        ? await resolveEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(
            capability,
            1,
            capabilityProbeServiceId,
            provider,
          )
        : await resolveEnvironmentBufferedProcessCapabilityProvider(
            capability,
            1,
            capabilityProbeServiceId,
            provider,
          );
    if (disposed) return;
    if (handle == null) {
      setState(() {
        selection = 'selection:unavailable';
      });
      return;
    }
    handles.add(handle);
    client = CapabilityProbeServiceClient(
      EnvironmentCapabilityRequestChannel(handle),
    );
    setState(() {
      selection = 'selected';
    });
  }

  void run(dynamic selected, String action) async {
    if (selected == null || disposed) return;
    setState(() {
      text = 'process:pending';
    });
    final CapabilityProbeServiceClient typed = selected;
    final result = await settleEnvironmentCapabilityOperation(
      typed.read(action),
    );
    if (disposed) return;
    if (result[0] == true) {
      final ProbeValue value = result[1];
      setState(() {
        text =
            '${value.provider}|${value.configuration}|${value.sequence}|${value.text}';
      });
    } else {
      setState(() {
        text = 'process:unavailable';
      });
    }
  }

  void ordinary() {
    final handle = resolveCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      1,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      'test.callable.a',
    );
    if (handle == null) return;
    run(CapabilityProbeServiceClient(CapabilityRequestChannel(handle)), 'hash');
  }

  void forge() async {
    if (handles.isEmpty) return;
    final result = await settleEnvironmentCapabilityOperation(
      EnvironmentCapabilityRequestChannel(
        handles.last,
      ).request('$capabilityProbeServiceId.read', <String, Object?>{
        'scope': 'files',
        'environmentId': 'primary',
        'providerId': 'test.environment.b',
        'hostInvocationContext': 'forged',
      }),
    );
    if (disposed) return;
    setState(() {
      text = result[0] == false ? 'forgery:rejected' : 'forgery:accepted';
    });
  }

  void checkDenied() async {
    final service = await resolveEnvironmentBufferedProcessCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      1,
      'wrong-service',
      null,
    );
    final version = await resolveEnvironmentBufferedProcessCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      2,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      null,
    );
    final undeclared =
        await resolveEnvironmentBufferedProcessCapabilityProvider(
          'test.undeclared',
          1,
          capabilityProbeServiceId,
          null,
        );
    final contextFree =
        await resolveEnvironmentBufferedProcessCapabilityProvider(
          capability,
          1,
          capabilityProbeServiceId,
          'test.callable.context-free',
        );
    final missing = await resolveEnvironmentBufferedProcessCapabilityProvider(
      capability,
      1,
      capabilityProbeServiceId,
      'missing',
    );
    if (disposed) return;
    setState(() {
      text =
          service == null &&
              version == null &&
              undeclared == null &&
              contextFree == null &&
              missing == null
          ? 'denials:passed'
          : 'denials:failed';
    });
  }

  void release() {
    bool released = false;
    for (final handle in handles) {
      if (releaseEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(handle)) released = true;
    }
    setState(() {
      selection = released ? 'released' : 'already released';
    });
  }

  @override
  void dispose() {
    disposed = true;
    for (final handle in handles) {
      releaseEnvironmentCapabilityProvider(handle);
    }
    super.dispose();
  }

  Widget actions() => Column(
    children: [
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'hash');
        },
        child: Text('hash'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'files');
        },
        child: Text('files'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'empty');
        },
        child: Text('empty'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'nonzero');
        },
        child: Text('nonzero'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'held');
        },
        child: Text('held'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'one');
        },
        child: Text('one'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'two');
        },
        child: Text('two'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'fresh');
        },
        child: Text('fresh'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'stdin-bound');
        },
        child: Text('stdin-bound'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'stdout-overflow');
        },
        child: Text('stdout-overflow'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'timeout');
        },
        child: Text('timeout'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'unavailable');
        },
        child: Text('unavailable'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'read-service');
        },
        child: Text('read-service'),
      ),
      TextButton(
        onPressed: () {
          run(client, 'foreign-id');
        },
        child: Text('foreign-id'),
      ),
    ],
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) => Column(
    children: [
      Text(selection),
      Text(text),
      Column(
        children: [
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              select(null, false);
            },
            child: Text('Default'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              select('test.callable.a', false);
            },
            child: Text('Select A'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              select('test.callable.b', false);
            },
            child: Text('Select B'),
          ),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              select(null, true);
            },
            child: Text('Read grant'),
          ),
          TextButton(onPressed: ordinary, child: Text('Ordinary')),
          TextButton(onPressed: checkDenied, child: Text('Check denials')),
          TextButton(onPressed: forge, child: Text('Forge payload')),
          TextButton(onPressed: release, child: Text('Release')),
          TextButton(
            onPressed: () {
              run(
                CapabilityProbeServiceClient(
                  EnvironmentCapabilityRequestChannel('forged'),
                ),
                'hash',
              );
            },
            child: Text('Forged handle'),
          ),
          actions(),
        ],
      ),
    ],
  );
}
